'''Deadly touch''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. Ascendants using deadly touch could inflict pain on an individual as long as they were in contact with them. Casters of deadly touch were required to know the [[sense life]] spell to learn deadly touch.
